pr.title: feat(code): add git::worktree_branches to detect branches held elsewhere
pr.body:
Adds the primitive the rest of the worktree work builds on: `worktree_branches()` lists the branches checked out in *other* worktrees along with the directory holding each, and `worktree_holding()` answers the single-branch question callers mostly ask. Plus `display_path`, which shortens those paths to `../wt-a` when it safely can, so the messages built on them stay pasteable.

Parsing is split into a pure function so it is tested against fixture porcelain, including the bare and detached records that hold no branch. No behavior change on its own.

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #274
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->

expected.description: parse_worktree_branches compares the canonicalized current worktree with the raw porcelain path, so when the two spellings differ (a symlinked checkout, /tmp vs /private/tmp on macOS) the current worktree's own branch is reported as held by another worktree.
